title: drought — apart from

sentences.sentence: ...a country where drought and famines have killed up to two million people during the last eighteen years.
sentences.translation: …过去18年来干旱和饥荒致死达两百万人的一个国家。

phrases.translation: 联邦机构；联邦政府机构
美国联邦存款保险公司
联邦贸易委员会，联邦商务委员会（FTC）
联邦特区（联邦政府所在地区，等于Federal District）
联邦快递，美国联邦快递公司

sentences.sentence: Switzerland is a federal republic.
sentences.translation: 瑞士是一个联邦共和国。

phrases.translation: ◎[美国、加拿大英语]在(印第安人)居留地之内
附有权益保留；有保留地
对某项声明所持的保留

sentences.sentence: We condemn their actions without reservation (= completely ) .
sentences.translation: 我们严厉谴责他们的行为。

sentences.sentence: The priest sacrificed a chicken.
sentences.translation: 牧师献祭了一只鸡。

sentences.sentence: We have to take action.
sentences.translation: 我们必须采取行动。

sentences.sentence: If business success is what you want, than you need to take action.
sentences.translation: 但是，如果你想取得商业上的成功，那你就必须采取行动。

sentences.sentence: But at what point do we decide to take action?
sentences.translation: 但是我们应该什么时候决定采取行动呢？

phrases.translation: 故意持相反意见的人；故意唱反调的人

sentences.sentence: Extremists were openly advocating violence.
sentences.translation: 极端主义者公开鼓吹使用暴力。

sentences.sentence: We take all our bottles to be recycled.
sentences.translation: 我们把我们所有的瓶子都回收利用。

sentences.sentence: packaging made of recycled paper
sentences.translation: 再生纸包装材料

sentences.sentence: Germany brought on a substitute at half time.
sentences.translation: 德国队在比赛半场时换上一名替补队员。

sentences.sentence: substitute goalkeeper
sentences.translation: 替补守门员

sentences.sentence: Postal workers are threatening a strike if they don’t receive a pay increase.
sentences.translation: 邮政工人威胁如果不加薪，他们就要罢工。

sentences.sentence: Does that mean we can go forward to visit those universes ahead of us?
sentences.translation: 这是否意味着我们能够前进到在我们前面的那些宇宙里去拜访他们？

sentences.sentence: The classic example is tossing a pancake so it flips over in mid-air.
sentences.translation: 最经典的例子是摊薄饼的时候，颠勺时薄饼就会飞到半空中。

sentences.sentence: The package says baking and pancake mix, but the pancakes were not tasty without some major tweaking to the recipe.
sentences.translation: 包装盒上说烤焙与薄饼面料混合，但没有添加一些主要调料，薄饼是不好吃的。

sentences.sentence: They are so-called “ pancake people ”, they no longer concentrate their energies on one area of interest, but instead choose to spread themselves thinly over a large area.
sentences.translation: 他们就是所谓的“煎饼人”，他们不再将精力专注于某一个感兴趣的领域，而是让自己的关注点浅浅地散布在一个很大的范围。

phrases.translation: n. 防风灯；飓风灯；马灯

sentences.sentence: Many buildings were demolished by a hurricane.
sentences.translation: 许多房屋被飓风摧毁。

sentences.sentence: Many coastal towns were desolated by the hurricane.
sentences.translation: 许多沿海城镇遭到飓风袭击而荒芜。

sentences.sentence: That means the water in one hurricane weighs more than all the elephants on the planet. Perhaps even more than all the elephants that have ever lived on the planet.
sentences.translation: 这就意味着飓风中所含的水比地球上所有的大象加到一起还要重，也许会超过地球上曾经有过的所有大象体重的总和。

sentences.sentence: Seven species of birds of prey have been observed.
sentences.translation: 已有七种猛禽被观察到。

sentences.sentence: pandas and other endangered species
sentences.translation: 熊猫以及其他濒危物种

sentences.sentence: The leopard's skin is marked with black spots.
sentences.translation: 豹皮上有黑色斑点。

sentences.sentence: The young leopard separated from its mother would be eaten by other beast.
sentences.translation: 与母亲离散的幼豹很可能被其他的野兽吃掉。

sentences.sentence: Her talent was not in gathering information but in analyzing and assessing—a meticulous organizer who plotted and planned with the cunning of a leopard.
sentences.translation: 她的才华不在信息收集，而在于分析和评估，一个细微谨慎的组织者，策划着，盘算着有如美洲豹般的狡猾。

sentences.sentence: The pathological diagnosis showed the crested ibis tuberculosis. It is pointed out that it could be a cause of inhibiting crested ibis population increment.
sentences.translation: 病理学诊断为朱鹮结核病，表明朱鹮结核病可能是影响朱鹮种群扩大的一个不容忽视的原因。

sentences.sentence: Central China's Henan province announced plans to build breeding bases for endangered wildlife including snow leopards, rhesus monkeys and crested ibis over the next five years, according to Xinhua .
sentences.translation: 新华社消息，中部省份河南省计划在未来五年内为包括雪豹、猕猴、朱鹮在内的多种濒危野生动物建立繁育基地。

sentences.sentence: alligator shoes
sentences.translation: 短吻鳄皮皮鞋

sentences.sentence: Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.
sentences.translation: 恐龙已灭绝数千万年了。

sentences.sentence: Pandas could become extinct in the wild.
sentences.translation: 熊猫在野生环境中可能会绝种。

sentences.sentence: an extinct species
sentences.translation: 已灭绝的一个物种

sentences.sentence: watching monkeys in their natural habitat
sentences.translation: 观察自然生活环境中的猴子

sentences.sentence: The grassland is an important habitat for many wild flowers.
sentences.translation: 这片草原是很多野花的重要生长地。

phrases.translation: 龟甲；一种类似龟甲的蝴蝶

sentences.sentence: The tortoise crept along at a very slow speed.
sentences.translation: 乌龟以极慢的速度向前爬。

sentences.sentence: Run like a tortoise.
sentences.translation: 像乌龟一样慢慢跑。

sentences.sentence: We didn’t see anyone all day, apart from a couple of kids on the beach.
sentences.translation: 除了海滩上的几个小孩，我们一整天没见到什么人。

sentences.sentence: Apart from the ending, it’s a really good film.
sentences.translation: 除了结局，这部电影真的不错。

text:
英语词汇 · 北师高中 · 第 104 单元

drought
音标：英 /draʊt/  美 /draʊt/
n. 旱灾
短语：drought resistance — 耐旱性，抗旱性
短语：drought relief — 干旱救灾
短语：drought control — 抗旱；防旱
例句：...a country where drought and famines have killed up to two million people during the last eighteen years.
…过去18年来干旱和饥荒致死达两百万人的一个国家。

federal
音标：英 /'fed(ə)r(ə)l/  美 /'fɛdərəl/
adj. 联邦的
短语：federal reserve — （美国）联邦储备系统
短语：federal government — 联邦政府
短语：federal law — 联邦法律
短语：federal funds — 联邦资金
短语：federal court — 联邦法院
短语：federal budget — 联邦预算
短语：federal reserve board — （美国）联邦储备金监察小组
短语：federal communications commission — 联邦通信委员会
短语：federal reserve bank — （美）联邦储备银行
短语：federal agency — 联邦机构；联邦政府机构
短语：federal bureau of investigation — n. （美）联邦调查局
短语：federal funds rate — 联邦基金利率
短语：federal deposit insurance corporation — 美国联邦存款保险公司
短语：federal trade commission — 联邦贸易委员会，联邦商务委员会（FTC）
短语：federal republic of germany — 德意志联邦共和国
短语：federal reserve system — （美）联邦准备制度
短语：federal tax — （美）联邦税
短语：federal aviation administration — [运输工程]联邦航空管理局
短语：federal district — 联邦特区（联邦政府所在地区，等于Federal District）
短语：federal express — 联邦快递，美国联邦快递公司
例句：Switzerland is a federal republic.
瑞士是一个联邦共和国。

reservation
音标：英 /rezə'veɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,rɛzɚ'veʃən/
n. 存疑；保留（意见）
短语：hotel reservation — 酒店预订；订旅馆
短语：make a reservation — 预定（房间、票）；预约
短语：without reservation — 无保留地
短语：ticket reservation — 预订票，订座
短语：make reservation — 预订
短语：on the reservation — ◎[美国、加拿大英语]在(印第安人)居留地之内
短语：with reservation — 附有权益保留；有保留地
短语：mental reservation — 对某项声明所持的保留
例句：We condemn their actions without reservation (= completely ) .
我们严厉谴责他们的行为。

sacrifice
音标：英 /'sækrɪfaɪs/  美 /'sækrɪfaɪs/
vt&vi. 牺牲；献出
短语：human sacrifice — 人祭；活人献祭
短语：at the sacrifice of — 以牺牲…为代价
例句：The priest sacrificed a chicken.
牧师献祭了一只鸡。

take action
采取行动
例句：We have to take action.
我们必须采取行动。
例句：If business success is what you want, than you need to take action.
但是，如果你想取得商业上的成功，那你就必须采取行动。
例句：But at what point do we decide to take action?
但是我们应该什么时候决定采取行动呢？

advocate
音标：英 /'ædvəkeɪt；-ət/  美 /ˈædvəkeɪt；-et/
vt. 主张，提倡
短语：devil's advocate — 故意持相反意见的人；故意唱反调的人
例句：Extremists were openly advocating violence.
极端主义者公开鼓吹使用暴力。

recycle
音标：英 /riː'saɪk(ə)l/  美 /,ri'saɪkl/
vt. 回收利用
短语：recycle bin — 回收站；资源回收筒
短语：recycle gas — 回注气，循环气
例句：We take all our bottles to be recycled.
我们把我们所有的瓶子都回收利用。
例句：packaging made of recycled paper
再生纸包装材料

substitute
音标：英 /'sʌbstɪtjuːt/  美 /'sʌbstɪtut/
n. 代替品，代用品
短语：substitute for — 代替，取代
短语：substitute fuel — 代用燃料
短语：substitute material — 代用材料，代用品
短语：substitute teacher — 代课老师
短语：blood substitute — [医]血液代用品
短语：substitute product — 互替产品；代用产品
短语：substitute function — 代用函数
例句：Germany brought on a substitute at half time.
德国队在比赛半场时换上一名替补队员。
例句：substitute goalkeeper
替补守门员

threaten
音标：英 /'θret(ə)n/  美 /'θrɛtn/
vt. 威胁
例句：Postal workers are threatening a strike if they don’t receive a pay increase.
邮政工人威胁如果不加薪，他们就要罢工。

ahead of
在……前面
例句：Does that mean we can go forward to visit those universes ahead of us?
这是否意味着我们能够前进到在我们前面的那些宇宙里去拜访他们？

pancake
音标：英 /'pænkeɪk/  美 /'pænkek/
n. 薄煎饼
例句：The classic example is tossing a pancake so it flips over in mid-air.
最经典的例子是摊薄饼的时候，颠勺时薄饼就会飞到半空中。
例句：The package says baking and pancake mix, but the pancakes were not tasty without some major tweaking to the recipe.
包装盒上说烤焙与薄饼面料混合，但没有添加一些主要调料，薄饼是不好吃的。
例句：They are so-called “ pancake people ”, they no longer concentrate their energies on one area of interest, but instead choose to spread themselves thinly over a large area.
他们就是所谓的“煎饼人”，他们不再将精力专注于某一个感兴趣的领域，而是让自己的关注点浅浅地散布在一个很大的范围。

hurricane
音标：英 /ˈhʌrɪkən/  美 /ˈhɜːrəkeɪn/
n. 飓风
短语：hurricane katrina — 卡特里娜飓风
短语：hurricane lamp — n. 防风灯；飓风灯；马灯
例句：Many buildings were demolished by a hurricane.
许多房屋被飓风摧毁。
例句：Many coastal towns were desolated by the hurricane.
许多沿海城镇遭到飓风袭击而荒芜。
例句：That means the water in one hurricane weighs more than all the elephants on the planet. Perhaps even more than all the elephants that have ever lived on the planet.
这就意味着飓风中所含的水比地球上所有的大象加到一起还要重，也许会超过地球上曾经有过的所有大象体重的总和。

species
音标：英 /'spiːʃiːz; -ʃɪz; 'spiːs-/  美 /'spiʃiz/
n. （动植物的）物种
短语：species diversity — 物种多样性；歧异度
短语：species composition — 物种组成；种类成分
短语：species richness — 物种丰富度；种繁富度
短语：species abundance — 物种丰度
短语：species group — 种群；种组
例句：Seven species of birds of prey have been observed.
已有七种猛禽被观察到。
例句：pandas and other endangered species
熊猫以及其他濒危物种

leopard
音标：英 /'lepəd/  美 /'lɛpɚd/
n. 豹
短语：snow leopard — 雪豹
短语：clouded leopard — 云豹
短语：leopard cat — 豹猫
例句：The leopard's skin is marked with black spots.
豹皮上有黑色斑点。
例句：The young leopard separated from its mother would be eaten by other beast.
与母亲离散的幼豹很可能被其他的野兽吃掉。
例句：Her talent was not in gathering information but in analyzing and assessing—a meticulous organizer who plotted and planned with the cunning of a leopard.
她的才华不在信息收集，而在于分析和评估，一个细微谨慎的组织者，策划着，盘算着有如美洲豹般的狡猾。

crested ibis
n. 朱鹮
例句：The pathological diagnosis showed the crested ibis tuberculosis. It is pointed out that it could be a cause of inhibiting crested ibis population increment.
病理学诊断为朱鹮结核病，表明朱鹮结核病可能是影响朱鹮种群扩大的一个不容忽视的原因。
例句：Central China's Henan province announced plans to build breeding bases for endangered wildlife including snow leopards, rhesus monkeys and crested ibis over the next five years, according to Xinhua .
新华社消息，中部省份河南省计划在未来五年内为包括雪豹、猕猴、朱鹮在内的多种濒危野生动物建立繁育基地。

alligator
音标：英 /'ælɪgeɪtə/  美 /'æləˌɡetɚ/
n. 短吻鳄
短语：alligator sinensis — 扬子鳄；中国鳄
例句：alligator shoes
短吻鳄皮皮鞋

extinct
音标：英 /ɪk'stɪŋkt; ek-/  美 /ɪk'stɪŋkt/
adj. 灭绝的,绝种的
短语：become extinct — 灭绝；绝种
例句：Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.
恐龙已灭绝数千万年了。
例句：Pandas could become extinct in the wild.
熊猫在野生环境中可能会绝种。
例句：an extinct species
已灭绝的一个物种

habitat
音标：英 /'hæbɪtæt/  美 /'hæbə'tæt/
n. 栖息地
短语：habitat destruction — 生境破坏；毁坏栖息地
短语：habitat condition — 居住条件
例句：watching monkeys in their natural habitat
观察自然生活环境中的猴子
例句：The grassland is an important habitat for many wild flowers.
这片草原是很多野花的重要生长地。

tortoise
音标：英 /ˈtɔ:təs/  美 /ˈtɔrtəs/
n. (陆)龟
短语：tortoise shell — 龟甲；一种类似龟甲的蝴蝶
例句：The tortoise crept along at a very slow speed.
乌龟以极慢的速度向前爬。
例句：Run like a tortoise.
像乌龟一样慢慢跑。

apart from
除……以外
例句：We didn’t see anyone all day, apart from a couple of kids on the beach.
除了海滩上的几个小孩，我们一整天没见到什么人。
例句：Apart from the ending, it’s a really good film.
除了结局，这部电影真的不错。
